description: Batch08: 80 original bilingual A2–C1 drafts; separate uncompleted English sense, Burmese, example, CEFR and audio review tasks; all C1 levels provisional.

english_definition_review.task: Independently verify exact English dictionary sense and POS with observed source, date and reviewer.

burmese_review.task: Independent Burmese editor checks sense, naturalness and register.

example_review.task: Independent reviewer checks grammar, collocation and intended sense.

cefr_review.task: Verify CEFR for this exact sense and POS; reclassify or quarantine unsupported placement.

audio_review.task: After approval, generate and actually listen to George and Emma word/example audio; test real iPhone Safari.
